name: Light Space Rasterization for T_light
definition: A method to compute T_light, the front-facing occlusion transmittance for each Gaussian along the sun direction. It uses a light-space rasterization pass with a distant narrow FOV perspective camera to approximate parallel sun rays.
summary: Light Space Rasterization computes front-facing occlusion transmittance for 3D Gaussians using a virtual light camera, differing from voxel-based fallbacks by providing full continuous gradients and zero parameter expansion.
